basis: Brain malformations and developmental disability define the syndrome; strabismus 80-99% and hypermetropia 30-79% support ocular dysfunction. Hypermobility alone lacks documented damage.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: hypermobility occurs in 30-79%, but no associated tissue injury or functional loss is established; skeletal deformities occur in 5-29%.

basis: Cranial hyperostosis and metaphyseal dysplasia define disease. Hearing impairment, optic atrophy and facial palsy lack evidence establishing a frequency of at least 30%.

decisions.otologic: none: mixed hearing impairment is reported without frequency; involvement in at least 30% of this recessive subtype is not established.

basis: Neural tube closure defects define disease; spina bifida includes defective vertebral arch formation, while anencephaly includes cranial and brain maldevelopment.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: the spina bifida parent and anencephaly/spina bifida phenotype include defining vertebral or cranial skeletal defects.

basis: Cerebellar dysfunction and intellectual disability define disease; persistent strabismus affects ocular alignment and binocular function in 30-79%. Constipation alone lacks evidence of gut damage.

decisions.ocular: involved: strabismus is annotated at 30-79% and represents persistent ocular alignment dysfunction rather than a transient sign.

basis: Intellectual disability and eye abnormalities define this syndrome. Unspecified dwarfism does not establish skeletal dysplasia or endocrine disease.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: dwarfism alone does not specify bone, joint or muscle pathology; no skeletal abnormalities are supplied.

basis: Callosal dysgenesis defines disease; pes planus 2/2 and radial dislocation 1/2; strabismus 1/2; congenital enteric aganglionosis with megacolon 1/2. Estimates are from very small samples.

decisions.gastrointestinal: involved: congenital enteric aganglionosis with megacolon occurs in 1/2; this is direct developmental bowel involvement, not merely a later disease risk.

basis: Inherited tubulointerstitial nephropathy with defining hyperuricemia (3/6); intrinsic anemia 5/5 and leukopenia 2/5 support blood involvement. Gout is a separate disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hyperuricemia is a defining urate-handling metabolic abnormality of this nephropathy, documented in 3/6 patients.

basis: Perineal hypospadias (80-99%) is a structural urethral defect. Other genital findings are reproductive; mixed blood lineages and pigment patches do not establish functional damage.

decisions.renal: primary: supplied HPO reports perineal hypospadias in 80-99%; the malformed urethra falls explicitly within the renal axis, despite the reproductive presentation.

basis: Retinal dystrophy defines LCA. Supplied HPO places seizures, neuronal migration defects and cerebellar malformations at 30-79%, supporting CNS involvement despite umbrella heterogeneity.

decisions.neurologic: involved: supplied 30-79% annotations include seizures and structural brain abnormalities; no evidence establishes that these frequencies apply only to a rare subtype.

basis: Myocardial amyloid infiltration defines this cardiac ATTR subtype. Protein misfolding alone does not establish metabolic disease; neuropathy is 1-4% and other extracardiac damage below 30%.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: amyloidogenic TTR misfolding establishes a deposition disorder, without evidence here of an endocrine or inborn metabolic disorder.
